scripts.build: bun run build:types && wrangler deploy src/index.ts --dry-run --minify --outdir dist/worker --name api --compatibility-date 2026-05-24 --compatibility-flags nodejs_compat
scripts.lint:system-boundary: bun run scripts/check-system-context-boundary.ts && bun run scripts/check-shared-system-source.ts
scripts.check: bun run gen:app:check && bun run lint:api-foundation && bun run lint:route-authorization && bun run lint:system-boundary && bun run lint:company-source && bun run lint:context-boundaries && bun run lint:deploy-safety && bun run lint:sql-bind-cast && bun run verify-seed && bun run build:types && tsc --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: bun run db:repair-migration-history:local && wrangler d1 migrations apply bedrock --local
scripts.db:migrate: bun run db:repair-migration-history && wrangler d1 migrations apply bedrock --remote
scripts.build:types:bundle: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && dts-bundle-generator -o dist/app.bundle.d.ts dist/api/app.d.ts --project tsconfig.dts.json --no-check --external-inlines drizzle-orm --external-inlines zod
